verdict.rationale: Twenty documents workflows that run without user involvement: they trigger on record changes, schedules, or incoming webhooks, and can chain record operations, HTTP requests, code, delays and AI Agent steps. Its docs also describe AI agents that execute multi-step tasks autonomously within the permission model. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended runs, documentation of run history/monitoring and execution limits for background jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Trigger workflows on record changes, schedules, manual actions, or incoming webhooks.
Workflows can chain any combination of: Record operations... Send email... HTTP request... Code... Branches... Iterator... AI Agent... Delay... Form
AI agents that work autonomously within your CRM — answering questions, enriching records, and executing multi-step tasks within your permission model.
AI agents go beyond chat — they can execute multi-step tasks autonomously: Enrich records with data from external sources
Workflows let you automate repetitive tasks and connect Twenty to external tools — without writing code (though you can if you want to).
